A consortium of funders supporting related solar geoengineering research included the Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation; Bill Gates is a frequent target of conspiracy narratives. Funding climate or geoengineering research is not evidence of a covert aircraft spraying program. In the 2018–2021 window, Debnath et al. report that chemtrails talk became semantically broader, more toxic, and more tied to demands to stop alleged spraying, while a smaller stream of tweets discussed legitimate environmental concerns such as ozone, biodiversity, and mitigation.
